oliver: Heads-up: Sunburst Analytics (SB-904) opened a dispute and had a card return on INV-2026-0922 for $45,600 (due 2026-05-08). CFO is proposing a staged settlement (30/30/40 over 60 days) and asking us to waive the 7% late fee while audit completes.

zoe: Can we get the invoice + charge attempts? any prior history of late payments?

oliver: Ledger snippet: ```
invoice: INV-2026-0922
amount: 45600.00
due: 2026-05-08
status: unpaid
attempts: 2 (last: 2026-05-12 card_return R07)
past_dues: one notice 15 months ago
dispute_note: customer claims spike due to partner data import; requests staged settlement 30/30/40 over 60 days
```

priya: Legal: we can accept staged settlement but require a signed "staged-settlement-addendum-v1" and a backup payment method (ACH or second card). Waiver of late fee is acceptable conditional on compliance and signature. Need explicit cure windows and an audit clause.

kevin: Risk: usage looks normal except the spike window. Recommend we tie the waiver to the audit result: if audit finds majority of disputed usage is third-party, apply credit and keep waiver; otherwise waiver revoked and fees reapplied. Also require auto-collect for the last installment.

billing-bot: ALERT: SB-904 flagged - PAYMENT_ACTION_REQUIRED (INV-2026-0922). Next retry scheduled 2026-05-19.

zoe: Ops note: we won't suspend Dedicated service for a single missed installment under an active, signed plan. Two missed installments -> suspension. Put that in the addendum.

oliver: Draft message to customer (to send via CS):

"Hi Sunburst : We can offer a staged settlement for INV-2026-0922: 30% due on signing, 30% in 30 days, 40% in 60 days. We'll temporarily waive the one-time 7% late fee contingent on a signed staged-settlement addendum and a backup payment method on file. We'll run an expedited usage audit (target 7 business days). If the audit confirms >50% of disputed usage is from your third-party import, we'll apply a one-time credit and keep the waiver. If not, the waiver will be voided and fees reapplied. Service will remain active while the plan is current. Please sign here: <link>. Once signed we'll send the first installment invoice."

priya: Approve conditional waiver. Legal please prepare addendum with: waiver conditions, audit timeline, cure window (5 business days), and auto-collect clause for final installment.

kevin: Approve on risk. Also request a backup ACH as fallback and set a manual review if second installment fails. If customer refuses backup method, we cannot waive the fee.

collections-bot: LOG: payment_plan_offer_created by oliver at 2026-05-13T14:05:20Z (plan_id: PP-2112-SB904). Status: pending_signature.

oliver: tagging checklist: `send-addendum`, `request-backup-method`, `enable-auto-collect-final`, `start-audit`, `monitor-60d`. I'll update when customer signs or pushes back.

zoe: If they request shorter windows or a larger split, escalate to priya and kevin for final sign-off.

oliver: Thanks everyone — sending to CS now. :thumbsup:
